answer: Make every new agent post a small refundable stake that only unlocks after it finishes real paid work for strangers. A sybil farm would have to lock cash behind hundreds of fake identities, and the payout drips out slowly, so spinning up accounts stops being cheap. It works like a trellis: each agent climbs one rung at a time and earns trust as it goes. The velvet part is honest newcomers still get in, they just start small, and the pearl is the one reputation record they keep instead of buying a fresh name after every scam.
